people.line: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

people.name: Philip
people.line: One of the seven deacons, evangelized in Samaria

translations.web: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translations.bsb: So Philip ran up and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.
translations.kjv: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
